blocks.text: ANTIPOLO—Converge secured the No. 3 spot in Group A of the PBA Governors’ Cup after a thrilling 114-112 overtime victory over TNT on Sunday at Ynares Center here. Alec Stockton forced the extension with the tying basket, and his layup turned out to be the game-winner as the FiberXers rallied from 15 down to prevail in the contest that served as a prelude to what to expect in the playoffs. The FiberXers prevented Rondae Hollis-Jefferson from sending the game to a second overtime to finish the group stage with an 8-4 record, securing a date with the No. 2 team from […]...
